news.title: Trump Media’s bitcoin holdings shrink as crypto losses hit $361 million

news.title: Bitwise's Rasmussen: Circle is mispriced as stablecoins head toward trillions

news.title: Strategy builds $4.75 billion cash cushion as only bitcoin isn’t enough for investors

news.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
news.summary: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

news.title: Solana lending giant Jupiter now lets the same dollar earn twice

news.title: Bitmine’s ETH buying slows as Tom Lee's firm shifts capital to share buybacks

news.title: Solana gets its first Strategy STRC product through Solstice Finance
news.summary: The Solana vault splits income from Strategy’s preferred stock into a lower-risk senior token and a higher-risk junior token.

news.title: Nvidia teams with Wall Street firms to help finance $500 billion for AI infrastructure
